title: Val Thorens with kids: ski schools, nursery and family tips
metaTitle: Val Thorens with kids: ski schools, nursery, family tips | SkiShare
description: Skiing in Val Thorens with kids: ski lessons from age 2, a nursery from 3 months, free beginner lifts, Family Flex and when to go. Updated for 2026/27.
keywords: val thorens ski school for children
is val thorens good for families
intro: Yes, Val Thorens works well for families: it holds the Famille Plus label, has four completely free beginner lifts, ski lessons from age 2 and a nursery that takes babies from 3 months. Children under 5 ski for free, and with Family Flex the parents pay the child price for their lift pass too. This guide covers what parents need to know for the 2026/27 season, from the resort's own websites and the ski schools themselves (checked 23 October 2026).

sections.heading: Is Val Thorens good for families?
paragraphs: Val Thorens holds the Famille Plus label. According to the resort's website, the label comes with six commitments, among them a welcome for families, lift pass discounts, activities for every age, on-site medical care for minor problems, and childcare.

The layout helps too. Les 3 Vallées describes a pedestrian-friendly village you can cross on foot in about 20 minutes, with a free shuttle between the areas. Val Thorens also has après-ski and nightlife, so if quiet evenings matter to you, ask what is near the apartment before you book. Which area suits families: [where to stay in Val Thorens](/en/guide/where-to-stay-in-val-thorens).

sections.heading: From what age can children learn to ski in Val Thorens?
paragraphs: The Val Thorens website lists many ski schools and says three of them have a secure ski kindergarten. The resort's beginners page names them: ESF, Prosneige (which, according to its own website, is becoming Audacius) and Evolution 2. These are the options by age, as the schools themselves publish them:

after: **Prices from ESF Val Thorens, as of October 2026,** 'from' prices for a week of 5 or 6 days: Mini Piou from €190, Piou-Piou mornings from €245, group lessons from age 5 from €245 in the morning, €230 in the afternoon and €368 for a full day, Super 6 mornings from €540, and Kids Club from €180. We did not find a price list marked 2026/27 for Prosneige or Evolution 2, so check their websites.
When it starts: according to ESF, Piou-Piou and Sifflote start on 6 December and children's group lessons on 7 December. Arriving earlier? Ask the school about a private lesson.

sections.heading: Nursery and babysitting: what to do with the little ones
paragraphs: According to ESF Val Thorens, its nursery is in the Montana building at the bottom of the resort and takes babies from 3 months: the Nurserie for 3 to 17 months and the Garderie for 18 to 36 months. You can book mornings (8:30 to 11:30), afternoons (14:00 to 17:00) or full days, for 5 or 6 days. Meals are extra, snacks are included, and there are rooms for naps. On its website, as of October 2026, a week of mornings or afternoons starts at €340 and a week of full days at €490.

What to bring, according to ESF: an up-to-date health record and proof that vaccinations are up to date, the completed health and allergy forms, a change of clothes, nappies, and a dummy or soft toy if your child has one. During the French school holidays you can visit the nursery between 17:30 and 18:30 to meet the staff.

For 3 to 5 year olds who don't ski all day, ESF runs a Kids Club without skiing, in the afternoons in high season, with limited places. Babysitters: the Val Thorens website has a list, and Les 3 Vallées advises booking in advance.

sections.heading: Where do beginners start? Free lifts and the beginner pass
paragraphs: According to SETAM, the Val Thorens lift company, four magic carpets are completely free: Campagnols, Musaraigne and the two Castor & Pollux carpets. The resort's website places them in two free learning areas: on the Voie Lactée piste next to Castor & Pollux, and another area next to Musaraigne and Campagnols.

When the children are ready to move on, there is the EasyRider pass: according to SETAM, for 4 hours or a day, at 50% of the normal price. It opens the green and blue pistes and five lifts: Cairn, 2 Lacs, Cascades, Moutière and Caron. According to the resort's website it is sold only at the lift pass sales points, and SETAM says that is also where you get a special beginners' map.

Once confidence grows, there are fun areas. According to Les 3 Vallées, the Piste de l'Espace and Expérience Spatiale, with tunnels, rollers and easy obstacles, are reached from the 2 Lacs lift, also with the EasyRider pass. There is also the VT Fun Ride, a 900 m run with tunnels, bridges and turns. The [official piste map](https://www.les3vallees.com/media/download/plan-val-thorens.pdf) also marks an Espace débutant and an Espace junior.

sections.heading: Lift passes for children: who pays and how much?
list: **Under 5:** the pass is free, but you collect it at the ticket office with a recent photo and an ID with the date of birth, such as a passport.
**5 to 17:** child price. **18 to 74:** adult price. **75 and over:** senior price.

**Family Flex:** the whole family, parents included, pays the child price. According to Les 3 Vallées, from 3 people: up to 2 adults, at least one child aged 5 to 17 and up to 6 children, for 5 ski days or more. The SETAM website says 6 to 21 days, so check the number of days before you buy.
**6 for the price of 5:** according to Les 3 Vallées, every 6-day pass costs the same as a 5-day pass.

**Children in lessons:** according to ESF, no pass is needed at the ski kindergarten (Piou-Piou and Sifflote). At the Ourson level no pass is needed for the first days, and the instructor will tell you when to buy one. Above that, children need a Val Thorens pass.
after: The prices of every pass: [Val Thorens ski pass prices 2026/27](/en/guide/val-thorens-ski-pass-prices).

sections.heading: When to go with children
list: **Early December:** the whole 3 Vallées area opens on 5 December 2026 (Val Thorens itself on 21 November). According to ESF, Piou-Piou and Sifflote start on 6 December and children's group lessons on 7 December, so a week starting Saturday 5 December works for lessons from the Sunday or Monday.

**French school holidays:** Christmas (19 December 2026 to 3 January 2027) and the February holidays (6 February to 7 March 2027, each French zone on a different two weeks). In those weeks ESF's Super 6 runs, and Les 3 Vallées advises booking lessons in advance so an instructor is free.

**End of the season:** the 3 Vallées area closes on 18 April 2027, but Val Thorens-Orelle stays open until 2 May. Note that according to ESF its nursery is closed for renovation from the week of 24 April, and Piou-Piou does not run that week. ESF suggests asking the tourist office if you need childcare.
after: Which weeks are cheap and which are busy, week by week: [the best time to ski in Val Thorens](/en/guide/best-time-to-ski-in-val-thorens).

sections.heading: What to do with the kids after ski school
list: **Cosmojet:** according to SETAM, the longest toboggan run in France: 5 km from 3,000 m, from the top of the Péclet Funitel, about 40 minutes down. Suitable from age 5. A child riding a sledge alone must be over 9 and taller than 1.25 m, and helmets are compulsory for everyone.
**The igloo village:** on the green Combe de Thorens piste. According to Les 3 Vallées, you can reach it on foot or on skis from the centre of the resort.
**More:** according to the Val Thorens website, sledging, snake gliss, dog sledding, snowshoeing, bowling and the sports centre.

sections.heading: Checklist for parents
list: **Book lessons and lift passes online in advance,** above all in the French school holidays (a tip from Les 3 Vallées).

**Choose an apartment close to the ski school.** According to ESF, the meeting point is in the confirmation email and in the MyESF app, and the nursery and Piou-Piou are in the Montana building at the bottom of the resort.

**Equipment:** according to ESF, equipment is not included in lessons. Children come with skis and boots, a helmet (compulsory), gloves, goggles and sun cream, and poles only from the 1ère étoile level.
**Insurance:** according to ESF, pupils are not insured by the school. You can add Carré Neige insurance to the lift pass, and travel insurance that covers skiing is worth having anyway.
**On the first day:** note the instructor's name and the sign they stand under, so you know where to go the next morning (an ESF tip).
**If your child has a phone:** install the Les 3 Vallées app for the whole family. According to Les 3 Vallées, that way you can see where everyone is on the slopes.

faqs.q: Is Val Thorens good for families?
faqs.a: Yes. Val Thorens holds the Famille Plus label, has four free beginner lifts, ski lessons from age 2 and a nursery from 3 months. Children under 5 ski for free, and with Family Flex the parents pay the child price too.

faqs.q: From what age can children ski in Val Thorens?
faqs.a: According to the schools themselves, from age 2 at Prosneige and from 2½ at ESF (Mini Piou). ESF group lessons from age 5 start at the Ourson level, and younger children learn at the ski kindergarten (Piou-Piou and Sifflote).

faqs.q: Is there a nursery for babies in Val Thorens?
faqs.a: Yes. According to ESF Val Thorens, its nursery in the Montana building takes children from 3 months to 3 years, for mornings, afternoons or full days. You need proof that vaccinations are up to date.

faqs.q: Do children need to pay for a lift pass in Val Thorens?
faqs.a: Under 5 the pass is free, but you collect it at the ticket office with a photo and an ID with the date of birth. From 5 to 17 children pay the child price, and with Family Flex the parents pay the child price too.

faqs.q: Are there free lifts for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes. According to the Val Thorens lift company, four magic carpets are completely free. After them, the EasyRider pass opens green and blue pistes at half the normal price.

faqs.q: When do children's ski lessons start in 2026/27?
faqs.a: According to ESF Val Thorens, Piou-Piou and Sifflote start on 6 December 2026 and children's group lessons on 7 December 2026. The whole 3 Vallées area opens on 5 December.
